mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.image_id) AS imageCount, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_name), '')) AS categoryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.disease_name LIKE '%健康%' OR d.disease_name LIKE '%正常%' OR d.disease_name LIKE '%无病虫害%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS healthyCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT (d.disease_name LIKE '%健康%' OR d.disease_name LIKE '%正常%' OR d.disease_name LIKE '%无病虫害%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abnormalCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2), 0) AS avgConfidence, COALESCE(ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2), 0) AS maxConfidence, COALESCE(ROUND(MIN(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0)) * 100, 2), 0) AS minConfidence, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS highConfidenceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) >= 0.7 AND COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) < 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS middleConfidenceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) < 0.7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lowConfidenceCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.warning_level LIKE '%高%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS highRiskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.warning_level LIKE '%中%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS middleRiskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.warning_level LIKE '%低%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lowRiskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.warning_level IS NULL OR TRIM(d.warning_level) = '' OR d.warning_level NOT REGEXP '高|中|低' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unmarkedRiskCount FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_name), ''), '未知结果') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_name), ''), '未知结果') ORDER BY count DESC, name

SELECT d.disease_name AS diseaseName, COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(k.plus_dsi_name) = TRIM(d.disease_name) THEN NULLIF(TRIM(k.plus_dsi_cmethod), '') END), MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(k.plus_dsi_cmethod), '')), MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_advice), '')), '知识库暂未收录该病虫害的防治建议' ) AS content FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN knowledge k ON k.isdeleted = 0 AND ( TRIM(k.plus_dsi_name) = TRIM(d.disease_name) OR FIND_IN_SET( TRIM(d.disease_name), REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE(COALESCE(k.plus_dsi_synonyms, ''), '、', ','), '，', ',' ), '；', ',' ), ';', ',' ) ) > 0 )
d.disease_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.disease_name) != '' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%健康%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%正常%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%无病虫害%'
GROUP BY d.disease_name ORDER BY d.disease_name

SELECT d.disease_id AS diseaseId, r.record_id AS recordId, d.image_id AS imageId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.record_no), ''), CONCAT('DISEASE-', d.disease_id)) AS recordNo, COALESCE(d.disease_result_img_url, i.image_result_url, i.image_url) AS imageUrl, d.disease_name AS categoryName, ROUND(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) * 100, 2) AS confidence, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.warning_level), ''), '未标记') AS riskLevel, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_result), ''), CONCAT('识别结果为', d.disease_name)) AS resultText, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_advice), ''), '') AS advice, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.model_name), ''), '未记录') AS modelName, DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id
d.disease_name IS NOT NULL AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%健康%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%正常%' AND d.disease_name NOT LIKE '%无病虫害%'
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) DESC, d.disease_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT d.disease_id AS diseaseId, r.record_id AS recordId, d.image_id AS imageId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.record_no), ''), CONCAT('DISEASE-', d.disease_id)) AS recordNo, COALESCE(d.disease_result_img_url, i.image_result_url, i.image_url) AS imageUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_name), ''), '未知结果') AS categoryName, ROUND(COALESCE(d.disease_confidence, 0) * 100, 2) AS confidence, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.warning_level), ''), '未标记') AS riskLevel, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_result), ''), CONCAT('识别结果为', COALESCE(d.disease_name, '未知结果'))) AS resultText, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.disease_advice), ''), '') AS advice, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.model_name), ''), '未记录') AS modelName, DATE_FORMAT(d.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM xwq_ai_disease d LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_record r ON r.record_id = d.record_id LEFT JOIN xwq_ai_image i ON i.image_id = d.image_id
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC, d.disease_id DESC
